metadata.title: MNIST Improvement Plan
metadata.objective: Improve MNIST accuracy above baseline without exceeding latency budget.

tasks.task: Evaluate the impact of the ensemble's KWTA parameter (`kwta_k`) on accuracy and latency.
tasks.scope: TRY: Vary the `kwta_k` parameter in `EnsembleMnistCNN` (defined in `pipeline/train_optuna.py` and used in `pipeline/train.py` and `eval/run_eval.py`) to understand its effect on model performance. FILES: `pipeline/train.py`, `eval/run_eval.py`, `pipeline/train_optuna.py`. CHANGE: Modify `train.py` to iterate through different `kwta_k` values, train the ensemble, and record accuracy and latency. VERIFY: Compare accuracy and latency for different `kwta_k` values against the baseline and identify optimal range.

tasks.task: Investigate alternative data augmentation strategies using Albumentations.
tasks.scope: TRY: Explore different augmentation techniques available in `Albumentations` beyond the current `Rotate`, `ShiftScaleRotate`, and `RandomBrightnessContrast`. FILES: `pipeline/train.py`. CHANGE: Modify the `AlbumentationsTransform` class in `pipeline/train.py` to include new augmentations (e.g., `Cutout`, `CoarseDropout`, `ElasticTransform`) and evaluate their impact on model accuracy. VERIFY: Achieve a measurable increase in test accuracy compared to the current augmentation setup without significantly increasing training time.

tasks.task: Extend Optuna hyperparameter optimization to include ensemble parameters.
tasks.scope: TRY: Integrate `num_sub_networks` and `kwta_k` of `EnsembleMnistCNN` into the Optuna hyperparameter search space. FILES: `pipeline/train_optuna.py`. CHANGE: Modify the `objective` function in `pipeline/train_optuna.py` to suggest values for `num_sub_networks` and `kwta_k` using `trial.suggest_int`. VERIFY: Optuna successfully explores different ensemble configurations and identifies a combination of hyperparameters that yields higher accuracy than the current fixed values.

tasks.task: Explore the effect of different `k` values in the internal `KWTA` activation function.
tasks.scope: TRY: Analyze the impact of varying the `k` parameter within the `KWTA` activation function (defined in `pipeline/kwta.py` and used in `pipeline/model.py`) on the performance of individual `MnistCNN` sub-networks. FILES: `pipeline/kwta.py`, `pipeline/model.py`, `pipeline/train.py`. CHANGE: Modify `pipeline/model.py` to allow `k` in `KWTA` to be a configurable parameter, then use `pipeline/train.py` to train models with different `k` values. VERIFY: Identify a `k` value that improves individual `MnistCNN` accuracy, potentially leading to better ensemble performance.

tasks.task: Implement and evaluate a different base model architecture for the ensemble.
tasks.scope: TRY: Replace the `ResNet18` base model in `MnistCNN` with a simpler or more complex CNN architecture (e.g., a custom simpler CNN or a pre-trained small MobileNet). FILES: `pipeline/model.py`, `pipeline/train.py`. CHANGE: Create a new model class in `pipeline/model.py` and update `MnistCNN` to use this new architecture. Train the ensemble with the new base model. VERIFY: The new architecture either achieves comparable accuracy with lower latency or significantly higher accuracy with acceptable latency.
